title: AuthPrincipal
description: The resolved authenticated principal. Account model: Tenant -> User -> Agent (stable principal) -> Credential (rotatable secret). Effective permission = role INTERSECT scopes INTERSECT tenant. Key format: dmbg_<env>_<keyid>_<secret> (only sha256(secret) is stored).

principal_id.description: Stable agent_id or user_id. Survives credential rotation; audit attributes to this.

credential_keyid.description: The <keyid> segment of the presented key (for agent principals). Lets us revoke one credential without rotating the principal.

scopes.description: Capability scopes granted to THIS credential. The agent can read + author + request deployment, but NEVER self-promote. deploy:live is unissuable at launch (paper-only by construction).

Scope.description: deploy:paper means 'may REQUEST a paper deployment that requires human acceptance' — it does not grant self-promotion.
